 29m ago Penalty for England! 
 31m ago GOAL! England 1-1 Croatia (Sučić 59) 
 1h ago HALF TIME: England 1-0 Croatia 
 1h ago GOAL! England 1-0 Croatia (Rogers 24)

 England captain Harry Kane celebrates after scoring from the penalty spot for England's second goal. Photograph: Tom Jenkins/The Guardian Scott Murray Thu 12 Nov 2026 16.33 EST First published on Thu 12 Nov 2026 13.00 EST Share Key events 27m ago GOAL! England 2-1 Croatia (Kane 64 pen) 
 29m ago Penalty for England! 
 31m ago GOAL! England 1-1 Croatia (Sučić 59) 
 1h ago HALF TIME: England 1-0 Croatia 
 1h ago GOAL! England 1-0 Croatia (Rogers 24) 
 2h ago Tuchel on Kane: 'the full package' 
 3h ago The teams 
 4h ago Preamble 
 49s ago 16.33 EST 90 min: Another sub for Croatia as Majer comes on for Kovačić. Majer will get four additional minutes’ worth of action.
 Share 1m ago 16.32 EST 89 min: Burn up the other end now, wresting at a corner with Pašalić, firstly to win a second corner, then rising above everyone to skim a header over the bar from close range! Not sure how the scoreline has remained 2-1 after the last few minutes of bedlam.
 Share 3m ago 16.31 EST 87 min: So nearly 3-1 … and then so nearly 2-2! Budimir, bursting into the England box down the right, has his shot deflected wide by Quansah’s fine lunge. From the corner, there’s some pinball, the ball spinning up off Burn but not quite falling for Gvardiol, six yards out. Then the whistle goes for some shoving. England breathe again, seconds after Croatia breathed again!
 Share 5m ago 16.29 EST 86 min: Gvardiol and Vlašić faff around down the England right. Rogers sticks out a leg to release Bellingham, who cuts back for Garner to slam home with authority. But the flag goes up correctly for offside.
 Share 7m ago 16.27 EST 84 min: Croatia are beginning to string a few things together, and England are struggling to get out of their final third. Modrić involved in such a lot of it, to nobody’s surprise.
 Share 8m ago 16.25 EST 82 min: Modric finds Vlašić by the right-hand side of the England D. Burn tugs away at Vlašić, operating on the very edge of legality. One more tug, and the referee would surely take action, but play continues and Vlašić, knocked off his equilibrium, eventually pulls a shot wide right.
 Share 10m ago 16.23 EST 81 min: The usual post-tranche-of-changes slump.
 Share 11m ago 16.22 EST 79 min: In the middle of that slew of substitutions, Croatia worked a half chance from a free kick for Budimir, who flapped at a header from six yards. Straight at Pickford in the soft style.
 Share 13m ago 16.21 EST 78 min: England respond with a triple change, removing Alexander-Arnold, Gordon and Rice and sending on Ngumoha, Garner and – still copping for a few boos – White. Bit early for pantomime season? It would seem not.
 View image in fullscreen Time for a slew of subs. Photograph: Tom Jenkins/The Guardian Share Updated at  16.33 EST 14m ago 16.20 EST 76 min: Croatia remove Smolčić and Mišić, sending on Modrić and Pašalić. Modrić wins his 207th cap, and receives a very warm welcome from both sets of fans as he comes on. Wembley doffing its collective cap to a great master.
 Share 17m ago 16.16 EST 74 min: … so having said that, Baturina makes good down the right and looks for Budimir with a diagonal. Budimir should burst through a gap down the inside-left, but the ball clunks off his shin and out for a goal kick.
 Share 18m ago 16.15 EST 73 min: England play keepball, and the clock ticks on. They’re looking comfortable.
 Share 20m ago 16.13 EST 71 min: Croatia make the first changes, replacing Sučić and Matanović with Budimir and Pašalić. When the game restarts, Gordon crosses from the left for Kane, who is penalised for getting too aggressive with his climb over Gvardiol.
 Share 21m ago 16.12 EST 69 min: England don’t deal with a ball bouncing into their box from the left. The ball makes it all the way through to Sučić, in space to the right. Sučić shoots low and hard, towards the bottom right, but Pickford handles well.
 Share 23m ago 16.10 EST 68 min: Of course, the closeness of this match means Thomas Tuchel can’t get fancy with his substitutions. He wants to see out the win. All of which may disappoint Richard Hirst: “Can’t wait to see Josh King make his England debut, either tonight or very soon. He’s going to develop into the best England 10 (role, not shirt number, to preempt any pedantry) since Johnny Haynes. What a coincidence that they both come from the same club.”
 Share 25m ago 16.08 EST 66 min: By the way, Smolčić was booked for his role in giving away that needless penalty. Slaven Bilic will be fuming.
 Share 26m ago 16.07 EST 65 min: Well, that was a quickfire exchange of gifts. Can’t everyone wait for Christmas?
 Share 27m ago 16.06 EST GOAL! England 2-1 Croatia (Kane 64 pen)
 Kane performs a little shuffle before waiting for the keeper to move and lashing the ball down the middle. That’s his 92nd goal for the Three Lions. Ninety-two goals! Wayne Rooney, in second spot, chalked up 52.
 View image in fullscreen England captain Harry Kane scores from the penalty spot. Photograph: Tom Jenkins/The Guardian View image in fullscreen Then wheels away in celebration. Photograph: Tom Jenkins/The Guardian View image in fullscreen Before celebration with his teammates. Photograph: Tom Jenkins/The Guardian Share Updated at  16.23 EST 29m ago 16.05 EST Penalty for England!
 63 min: VAR asks the on-field whistler to come over to the screen. Smolčić had a good old grab at Quansah’s arm, and only let go of the shirt when the England man was about to fall over. It’s got to be given. And it is.
 Share 30m ago 16.04 EST 61 min: England respond through Alexander-Arnold, who loops into the Croatia box, forcing Stanišić into deflecting the ball over the bar. From the resulting corner, Quansah, desperate to atone, competes with Smolčić, who has a hold of his shirt. Quansah goes over. He wants a penalty. The on-field referee says no, but VAR will take a look.
 Share 31m ago 16.02 EST GOAL! England 1-1 Croatia (Sučić 59)
 Croatia win a corner down the right. The ball’s sent into a crowded mixer. It drops to Quansah, who tries to head back to his keeper. Bad idea. The ball drops to Sučić, four yards out. Sučić swivels and hooks into the top left. Pickford had no chance, the nearby Kane stands and fumes. What on earth was Quansah doing?
 Share 33m ago 16.01 EST 58 min: Elliot Anderson played for Scotland at U16, U17, U18 and U21 levels. Chalk up another resounding success for the SFA!
 Share 34m ago 16.00 EST 56 min: Anderson, surrounded by blue shirts on the right, wriggles free with some outrageous ball-glued-to-toe skill. He spots the keeper miles off his line, so has a go from halfway … only to shank a dreadful effort miles wide and short. Fair play for giving it a go, because had that gone in, the lead-up would have ensured all-timer status.
 Share 35m ago 15.58 EST 55 min: Better from Gordon as he sashays in from the left and whip-curls a shot inches wide of the bottom right. A decent effort.
 Share 36m ago 15.57 EST 54 min: Rogers crosses low from the right. Gordon nips in to take control, and feels Mišić leaning on his back. He goes over, but doesn’t get the penalty he wants. The loose ball rebounds to Bellingham, who scuffs a low drive straight at Livaković. Easy for the keeper.
 Share 38m ago 15.55 EST 52 min: … nothing happens. Should Rice have taken the shot himself? He’d have been within his rights. But what do you do when Harry Kane is in your periphery? Defer, is what.
 Share 40m ago 15.54 EST 51 min: Rice might not be the most elegant dribbler, but he knows how to time a run into the box. He chases Rogers’ ball down the inside-right channel and pulls it back for Kane … who wouldn’t have missed from six yards, but Stanišić deflects out for a corner, from which …
 Share 41m ago 15.52 EST 49 min: Gordon cuts in from the left and aims a curler towards the top right. Nowhere near.
 Share 41m ago 15.52 EST 47 min: Rice has the opportunity to break into acres of space down the right. He races gamely, if ungainly, clanking the ball a couple of times down the wing before an even heavier touch allows Stanišić to come across and take it away. If Rice’s run had been set to music, it would have been set to the opening few bars of this …
 Share 46m ago 15.48 EST England get the second half started. No changes, so here’s Justin Kavanagh: “Say what you want about Emlyn Hughes, he must have brought a lot to traveling England squads in terms of the bus quizzes.”
 Share 1h ago 15.36 EST Half-time entertainment. Today’s mid-match distraction runs only on the Commodore 64.
 Share 1h ago 15.33 EST HALF TIME: England 1-0 Croatia
 There’s not been much to write home about. Like England will care. They’re leading, and now just 45 minutes away from officially booking their place in the Nations League quarter-finals.
 Share 1h ago 15.32 EST 45 min: There will be the sum total of zero additional first-half minutes.
 Share 1h ago 15.31 EST 44 min: Kovačić wins a corner off Rice down the left. A lot of blue shirts trot into the box. Kovačić takes it himself, and the ball bounces a couple of times in a crowded box before Hall belts it clear. England a wee bit fortunate that somehow evaded all of those aforementioned blue shirts, because that was a bit random.
 Share 1h ago 15.29 EST 42 min: Baturina finds a little time on the left for a shot. More easy work for Pickford. Meanwhile in the other Group A3 match, world and European champions Spain have taken the lead in Czechia. Alex Baena with a 39th-minute penalty.
 Share 1h ago 15.28 EST 40 min: Some bagatelle on the edge of the Croatia box. The ball breaks back to Alexander-Arnold, who fizzes a rising shot over the bar. Not too far away. That would have been one for the showreel had it hit the net.
 Share 1h ago 15.27 EST 39 min: More patient nonsense. “If Emlyn Hughes played in ‘all’ those years, that surely means from 1960 to 1989, he said, pedantically,” says Richard Hirst, pedantically. “That’s a longer international career than even Modric.” Pedants read the Guardian? Some breaking news, right there.
 Share 1h ago 15.24 EST 37 min: England play some patient stuff in the middle of the park. Thomas Tuchel will be happier to watch this state of affairs than the controller of ITV1.
 Share 1h ago 15.22 EST 35 min: A Croatia free kick out on the left. It’s floated towards Baturina, but Anderson is there to clear. Pickford hasn’t had a serious save to make yet. England counter, Rogers finding Bellingham in the box with a sliderule down the right. Bellingham spins and shoots first time, but there’s no power in this shot either, and Croatia clear their lines.
 Share 1h ago 15.20 EST 33 min: Kovačić looks for the top right from 25 yards. No real power, not enough curl. Easy for Pickford. Meanwhile here’s some much-needed good news for those interested in preserving the legacy of poor old Crazy Horse: “On the plus side,” begins Philip Cornwall, “Emlyn Hughes was the only man to play football for England in all of the 60s, 70s and 80s.”
 Share 1h ago 15.18 EST 31 min: Some Newcastle-flavoured fun as Hall’s long-distance drive is deflected out for a corner, from which Burn batters a headers goalwards. It’s blocked, and perhaps had the ball gone in, Burn would have been penalised for climbing fairly obviously on the back of Mišić. But play goes on, so we’ll never know for sure.
